name: Sapphic Space
source:
The ship needs repairs!

Play as Miss Yournamehere, the ship computer, and help the ship's android, Susu, get it up and running again!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464260/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
船需要修理！

扮演船上计算机Miss Yournamehere，帮助船上的机器人Susu重新启动并运行！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464260/]Steam[/url]]
